thread:
Ellen (Growth): Quick ask: were launching the benchmark + webinar next week. Need a focused SEO runbook today: final keyword set, minimal JSON-LD for Event+FAQ, internal-link anchor plan across launch posts, and a redirects + canonical mapping for the gated benchmark PDF. Can we lock this by EOD?
Marcus (SEO): I'll take keywords and schema. Proposing two pillars: "inference benchmark" and "LLM cost benchmarks" + four longtails. Sharing a tiny sheet after this thread.
Pri (Content): Internal linking plan: add one contextual link per launch post to /benchmark-summary, vary anchors ("benchmark findings", "benchmark overview", "benchmark results") to avoid exact-match stuffing. Add a hero CTA on the homepage pointing to webinar register.
Devon (Infra): Preference for gated slug: /downloads/benchmark-2026-report.pdf. I'll put 301s in the redirect CSV and add X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow on download responses.
Marcus (SEO): Minimal FAQ JSON-LD (drop into <head> of summary page):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What does the benchmark include?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Latency, throughput, and cost across model families and common configs."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is the full report downloadable?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The detailed report is gated; a public summary with key charts is available."}}]}
```
Marcus (SEO): Event JSON-LD stub for webinar (replace ISO date):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-06-10T18:00:00Z","description":"Live walkthrough of benchmark findings + Q&A","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar/register"}}
```
Devon (Infra): Redirect examples (nginx-style) I'll include in PR:
```
# launch redirects
rewrite ^/benchmark$ /benchmark-summary permanent; # landing -> summary
rewrite ^/benchmark/pdf$ /downloads/benchmark-2026-report.pdf permanent; # pdf -> gated slug
rewrite ^/webinar$ /webinar/register?src=launch permanent; # short -> register
```
Devon (Infra): Smoke tests to include in deploy notes:
```
# expect 301 -> summary
curl -I https://redwood.example.com/benchmark | grep -i Location
# gated pdf should return X-Robots-Tag header after auth service applied
curl -I https://redwood.example.com/downloads/benchmark-2026-report.pdf | grep -i X-Robots-Tag
```
Pri (Content): Canonical rules: summary page self-canonical to /benchmark-summary. Gated PDF: noindex, follow + X-Robots-Tag in response. For paginated launch series keep rel=prev/next; if duplication persists canonicalize to page 1. Also OG/Twitter meta should point to summary for social cards.
AuditBot: crawl-scan: found 8 posts with overlapping meta descriptions; recommend unique 120-155 char metas for launch series. Scheduled re-scan tomorrow 07:00 UTC.
Ellen (Growth): Deliverables by EOD: Marcus -> keyword file + JSON-LD snippets; Devon -> redirects CSV (columns: source_url,target_url,status_code,notes) + curl tests; Pri -> list of posts + anchor text to update + meta title suggestions. I'll lock email subject + CTA once artifacts are in drive.
Marcus (SEO): One more note: watch trailing slash normalization and query-string variants. Add tests for /benchmark/ -> 301 to /benchmark-summary and /benchmark?utm=* should preserve 301 mapping.
Devon (Infra): Noted. Will include normalization rules and a small linkcheck job post-deploy.
Ellen (Growth): Great. If everyone can drop their artifacts in the shared folder Ill do a final pass and sign off. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
